mapper.sql: enrollment_id, student_user_id, license_type, required_amount, planned_hours, status, submitted_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_note, paid_amount, payment_method, payment_voucher, paid_by, paid_at

SELECT e.enrollment_id, e.student_user_id, su.real_name AS student_name, su.phone, e.license_type, e.required_amount, e.planned_hours, e.status, e.submitted_at, e.reviewed_by, ru.real_name AS reviewed_by_name, e.reviewed_at, e.review_note, e.paid_amount, e.payment_method, e.payment_voucher, e.paid_by, pu.real_name AS paid_by_name, e.paid_at FROM enrollment e JOIN user_account su ON su.user_id = e.student_user_id LEFT JOIN user_account ru ON ru.user_id = e.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN user_account pu ON pu.user_id = e.paid_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (student_user_id, license_type, required_amount, planned_hours, status, submitted_at) VALUES (#{studentUserId}, #{licenseType}, #{requiredAmount}, #{plannedHours}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'SUBMITTED'), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollment SET license_type = #{licenseType}, required_amount = #{availableAmount}, status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = NOW(), reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, review_note = NULL WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND status = 'REJECTED'

UPDATE enrollment SET status = #{status}, required_amount = COALESCE(#{requiredAmount}, required_amount), planned_hours = COALESCE(#{plannedHours}, planned_hours), reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_note = #{reviewNote} WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE enrollment SET paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_voucher = #{paymentVoucher}, paid_by = #{paidBy}, paid_at = NOW(), status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND #{paidAmount} = required_amount
UPDATE enrollment SET status = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
